Load packages
```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidylog)
library(ggplot2)
set_theme(theme_minimal())
```

Read calculated overlaps (current and future scenarios) - updated using new interaction information.
```{r}
overlap_current <- read_csv(here("range_overlap/output/range_overlap_hosts_current.csv")) |> 
    mutate(scenario = "current")
overlap_fut26 <- read_csv(here("range_overlap/output/range_overlap_hosts_future_26.csv")) |> 
    mutate(scenario = "future26")
overlap_fut85 <- read_csv(here("range_overlap/output/range_overlap_hosts_future_85.csv"))|> 
    mutate(scenario = "future85")

overlap_all <- bind_rows(overlap_current, overlap_fut26, overlap_fut85)
```


```{r}
a <- overlap_current |> 
    group_by(Species) |> 
    summarise(hosts = n_distinct(Host),
    # mean_overlap = mean(Overlap_host, na.rm = TRUE),
    mistmatched = sum(Overlap_host == 0))

a |> arrange(desc(mistmatched)) |> 
    filter(mistmatched > 0) |> 
    select(Species, hosts, mistmatched)

ggplot(a, aes(x = mistmatched)) +
    geom_histogram()
```


```{r}
int_changes <- overlap_all |> 
    select(Species, Host, scenario, Overlap_host) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = scenario, values_from = Overlap_host) |>
    mutate(change_26 = future26 - current,
           change_85 = future85 - current) |> 
    mutate(change_type_26 = case_when(change_26 > 0 ~ "increase",
                                 change_26 < 0 ~ "decrease",
                                 change_26 == 0 ~ "no_change"),
           change_type_85 = case_when(change_85 > 0 ~ "increase",
                                 change_85 < 0 ~ "decrease",
                                 change_85 == 0 ~ "no_change")) 

int_changes |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = change_26)) +
    geom_histogram()

int_changes |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = change_85)) +
    geom_histogram()
           
p1 <- int_changes |>
    # only keep interactions that are present in the current scenario
    filter_out(current == 0 & future26 == 0 & future85 == 0) |>
    group_by(change_type_26) |>
    summarise(n = n_distinct(Species)) |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = 1, y = n, fill = change_type_26)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    labs(x = "Change in overlap (current to future 26)",
            y = "Number of interactions") +
    theme_minimal()

p2 <- int_changes |>
    filter_out(current == 0 & future26 == 0 & future85 == 0) |>
    group_by(change_type_85) |>
    summarise(n = n_distinct(Species)) |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = 1, y = n, fill = change_type_85)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    labs(x = "Change in overlap (current to future 85)",
            y = "Number of interactions") +
    theme_minimal() 

library(patchwork)
p1 + p2 + plot_layout(guides = "collect") + plot_annotation(title = "Changes in butterfly-host interactions under future scenarios")
```
